title: Oil-burning equipment installer place of business.
officialText:
Every licensed oil-burning equipment installer shall have a place of
business within the city. A licensed oil-burning equipment installer shall be a sole proprietor, a partner in the partnership or an officer
of the corporation.
ARTICLE 413
HIGH-PRESSURE BOILER
